zh: 我可以早点下班吗？
old_en: Can I leave work early today?
new_en: Can I leave work early today?

zh: 我可以借你的充电器用一下吗？
old_en: Can I use your charger for a moment?
new_en: Can I borrow your charger for a moment?

zh: 我可以带朋友来参加聚会吗？
old_en: Could I bring a friend to the party?
new_en: Can I bring a friend to the party?

zh: 今天我能带朋友一起过来玩吗？
old_en: May I bring a friend over to play today?
new_en: Can I bring a friend over to play today?

zh: 我可以把车停在门口吗？
old_en: Is it okay if I park my car by the door?
new_en: Is it okay to park my car by the door?

zh: 今天能提前离开办公室吗？
old_en: Could I leave the office early today?
new_en: Can I leave the office early today?

zh: 我可以在这里吃东西吗？
old_en: Can I eat here, please?
new_en: Can I eat here?

zh: 我能在会议室吃点东西吗？
old_en: May I have a snack in the meeting room?
new_en: Can I have a snack in the meeting room?

zh: 我可以晚点交作业吗？
old_en: Can I hand in my homework later?
new_en: Can I hand in my homework a bit later?

zh: 我可以先看菜单吗？
old_en: Can I have a look at the menu first?
new_en: Can I look at the menu first?

zh: 今天作业多，我能明天交吗？
old_en: Could I hand in my homework tomorrow instead of today?
new_en: I have a lot of homework today. Can I hand it in tomorrow?

zh: 我可以养只小狗吗？
old_en: Can I keep a little puppy?
new_en: Can I have a little puppy?

zh: 我可以刷卡付账吗？
old_en: Can I pay with a card, please?
new_en: Can I pay with a card?

zh: 能不能先用一下你的卡？
old_en: Can I use your card first?
new_en: Can I use your card first?

zh: 我先看看菜单可以吗？
old_en: May I take a look at the menu first?
new_en: Can I look at the menu first?

zh: 我可以在这里拍照吗？
old_en: Can I take a photo here, please?
new_en: Can I take a photo here?

zh: 我作业写得差不多了，可以明天交吗？
old_en: Can I hand in my homework tomorrow since I've finished most of it?
new_en: Can I hand in my homework tomorrow since I've almost finished it?

zh: 我能不能先在家里养几天？
old_en: Can I stay at home for a few days?
new_en: Can I stay at home for a few days first?

zh: 今天天气好，我们可以在公园拍张照吗？
old_en: Could I take a photo in the park today, the weather is so nice?
new_en: The weather is nice today. Can we take a photo in the park?

zh: 我能不能先养几天试试？
old_en: Can I try keeping it for a few days first?
new_en: Can I try keeping it for a few days first?
